info.title: Enterprise Forms Business API
info.description: Browser-facing business API generated from compiled feature endpoints (ADR-PB-006). The Authorization Authority contract is private and published separately.

get.summary: Process liveness. Never consults external dependencies.
Readiness. Fails closed when the Authorization Authority is unconfigured or unreachable.
Verified principal of the current assertion (projection maintenance only; confers no permission).
Current browser session (no secrets): authenticated flag, organization, CSRF token for mutations.
Synthetic personas seeded through the authority operator plane. 404 outside Development/Testing.

post.summary: Development/Testing only: starts a BFF session for a seeded persona. Refused elsewhere by construction.

get.summary: Authenticated bootstrap: user, capabilities, safe branding, UI preferences and current authorization revision (no record counts).

post.summary: Registers a form with the authority (designer role) and publishes a minimal v1 layout. Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Forms the caller may design or use (authority-filtered; no other forms are disclosed).

post.summary: Registers a new form with the authority and opens an empty draft (no published version yet). Requires Idempotency-Key.
Adds a stable field identity (storage type immutable after creation).

put.summary: Adds, relabels, reorders or deactivates options; keys and ids are stable, nothing is deleted.
Saves the draft layout (schema v2, validated) with draft-revision CAS.

post.summary: Atomically publishes the draft as an immutable version and advances the current pointer (expected draft revision + current version number).
Copies a published version into the draft; publishing creates a NEW version (history is never rewritten).
Defines a reusable related-form list (e.g. AccusedAddressList): parent → child form, bounds, cycle-checked.
Registers the record with the authority, validates typed values against the published layout, stages the signed candidate and commits the first accepted content revision.

get.summary: Authority-discoverable records with unverified local metadata; open a record for the verified projection.
Verified read: authority head → exact staged rows → complete manifest verification → authorized subset only.

patch.summary: Optimistic (expected_content_revision or If-Match) full-snapshot typed update staged as a new immutable candidate and committed by the authority.

get.summary: Verified projection for the UI: layout version, field metadata, authorized values and documents, permitted actions, ETag.
Authorized, verified child records of a related-form list (no hidden counts).

post.summary: Creates a child record linked to the parent through the authority (parent edge, signed header binding). Requires Idempotency-Key.
Authority UnlinkChildRecord command: removes the parent edge, keeps the data, remover becomes owner.
Opens an authorized, idempotent chunked upload session bound to a record's document collection field.

put.summary: Streams one exact-size chunk (4 MiB; last chunk remainder) into quarantine; acknowledged ranges are server truth.

post.summary: Idempotent finalize: assembles quarantined chunks and queues durable scan/encrypt processing. 202 = queued, not Ready.
Binds the processed (clean, encrypted) version into the record's signed manifest through the caller's authority context; the document becomes Ready.

get.summary: The caller's own upload sessions and their authoritative processing stage.
Documents whose version leaf is in the accepted manifest and authorized for the caller.
Authorized download: re-verifies the record projection, decrypts server-side, streams with no-store and attachment disposition.

post.summary: Removes the document from the accepted content by committing a new revision without its leaf; bytes and history are retained.
Explicit field allow-list share committed by the authority; no wildcard or future items.

get.summary: Authorized widget descriptors from the static catalog; no inline data, no arbitrary endpoints.
Counts computed only over resources discoverable by the caller.
Record activity timeline (local audit projection; authority Read permission required).

put.summary: OrganizationOwner only; WCAG pairwise contrast validated server-side; revision CAS.

get.summary: Display-name directory of users seen in this organization (projection; confers nothing).
